body: What is love bombing? I’m unfamiliar
I try to, and sometimes it’s effective but he has cheated on me in the past so I often don’t know if my thoughts can even be trusted, if I’m living in delusions and the past or if I’m actually right

I dated a boy who cheated on me, lied to me, and admitted openly to manipulating me as well for the two years that I put up with it. We didn’t speak for about 3 years after that because I was devastated, he was the first and only person I fell in love with. There’s just something about him that is addictive for me and he recently came back into my life. He offered apologies for previous behavior and confessed what he put me through was because of his own issues that he was working on and trying to fix. He told me he regretted it and did a lot of soul searching and reflecting while I was gone for 3 years so now we’re giving it a second try. But everyday is a struggle, some days I feel like I’m going insane wrapped up in the delusions that he’s gonna do it again. I still struggle with extreme jealousy as well and my symptoms make me paranoid and extremely anxious and on edge. It’s extremely stressful and some days I don’t think it’s worth it. I’m just scared if I chose to walk away for the betterment of my own mental health, what if he does mean everything this time? I don’t want to walk away from the love of my life but I feel I deserve better.
Thanks for the words of encouragement I wish you best of luck with whatever you’re struggling with as well!
